subject: Kickoff: Project Basalt — unified dataset interface
body:
Team — kicking off what we're calling Project Basalt internally: productizing our unified TFDS interface that fronts 20 segmentation and detection datasets (ADE20K, COCO, CityScapes, Mapillary, and the rest) behind standardized feature names.

The pitch for data-platforms: one loader, one schema — image, segmentation, boxes, person_keypoints — so experiment code runs unchanged across datasets, including the MSeg universal-taxonomy channel where every dataset shares one label space.

Milestones: feature-parity audit against fids_features.py by Feb 27; licensing review of all 20 sources by mid-March (WildDash is already excluded from redistribution; Kofi should confirm the others); Corpus integration prototype in April; launch review by May 4.

Bruno owns the resourcing follow-up. Please use the Basalt name on docs and threads so search works.

Dmitri
